info.title: Queue OpenAPI for meshy/relief
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the meshy/relief queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Turn a photo into a 3D-printable relief (STL, GLB) and a 2K 16-bit depth map.

variant.description: Relief depth. 'low' gives slight depth and finer detail (patterns, badges, seals); 'high' gives bold, sculptural depth (pets, portraits, characters).
variant.title: Variant

bend_mode.description: Bend the relief into a convex or concave curve.
bend_mode.title: Bend Mode

carving_mode.description: 'emboss' makes the nearer parts stand out; 'engrave' inverts the depth so they are cut in.
carving_mode.title: Carving Mode

remove_base.description: Cut away the background and build no base plate. A high removal_threshold, or a carving depth of 0, can produce an empty model.
remove_base.title: Remove Base

carving_depth_mm.title: Carving Depth Mm
carving_depth_mm.description: Carving depth in millimeters. Defaults to 3 for 'low' and 6 for 'high'.

bend_axis.description: Bend axis: 'xz' curls the left and right edges, 'yz' the top and bottom.
bend_axis.title: Bend Axis

removal_threshold.title: Removal Threshold
removal_threshold.description: Only used with remove_base. Depth below which the background is cut, on the depth map's 0-1 scale. Defaults to 0.01.

image_url.description: Photo to turn into a relief. Works best with one clear subject on a plain background. JPG, PNG or WebP up to 20 MB.
image_url.title: Image Url

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input data will be checked for safety before processing.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

bend_angle.description: Bend angle in degrees. Under 1 stays flat.
bend_angle.title: Bend Angle

base_thickness_mm.title: Base Thickness Mm
base_thickness_mm.description: Base plate thickness in millimeters. Defaults to 1. Not allowed with remove_base.

size_mm.description: Length of the photo's long side in millimeters, measured flat before any bend.
size_mm.title: Size Mm

should_generate_model.description: Generate the STL and GLB relief models. Set to false to return only the 16-bit depth map.
should_generate_model.title: Should Generate Model

mesh_resolution.description: Mesh points along the long side. At 2048, files reach about 150 MB (GLB) and 300 MB (STL), and a bend can push the STL to about 800 MB.
mesh_resolution.title: Mesh Resolution

ReliefInput.description: Input for Meshy Relief: a photo to a 3D-printable relief and depth map.
ReliefInput.title: ReliefInput

model_urls.description: Relief model files (GLB and STL). Empty when should_generate_model is false.

model_glb.description: Relief model in GLB format. Absent when should_generate_model is false.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
